# ailiu.online

> ailiu.online is the bilingual personal portfolio of a designer and AI builder. English is the default at the root path, with complete Chinese counterparts under /zh.

## English Pages

- [Home](https://ailiu.online/): Portfolio homepage covering product design, brand identity, AI-assisted building, and prototyping.
- [Aviso](https://ailiu.online/projects/aviso): Case study for a privacy-conscious Chrome extension with in-page AI commands, selected-text actions, local history, and direct BYOK model access.
- [Aunt’s Home](https://ailiu.online/projects/xiaoyi): Case study for a food-and-beverage identity spanning naming, visual language, menus, packaging, space, and wayfinding.

## 中文页面

- [首页](https://ailiu.online/zh)：设计师与 AI 构建者的个人作品集，涵盖产品设计、品牌视觉、AI 辅助构建与原型落地。
- [Aviso](https://ailiu.online/zh/projects/aviso)：注重隐私的 Chrome 扩展案例，提供页面内 AI 命令、划词操作、本地历史与 BYOK 模型直连。
- [小姨家](https://ailiu.online/zh/projects/xiaoyi)：从命名、视觉语言到菜单、包装、空间与导视的餐饮品牌设计案例。

## Public Profile

- GitHub: https://github.com/mongocyber

## Crawler Notes

Each English page and Chinese page is a language counterpart of the same portfolio content. Public pages may be used for search indexing and answer grounding. This file does not grant permission for model-training crawlers, private repositories, unpublished work, secrets, credentials, or non-public project materials.
